target_convention: ISB-style named positive rotations; paper-specific transforms require expert verification

McClure2001:ST_UpwardRotation_deg.description: Scapula relative to thorax; Euler sequence external/internal rotation, upward/downward rotation, posterior/anterior tilt.
McClure2001:ST_UpwardRotation_deg.proximal_coordinate_system: Thorax: ZT T7-to-T1; XT normal to T1-T7-SN plane; YT=ZT×XT
McClure2001:ST_UpwardRotation_deg.distal_coordinate_system: Scapula: XS root of spine to AC; YS normal to AC-SP-IA plane; ZS=XS×YS
McClure2001:ST_UpwardRotation_deg.reference_pose: Absolute anatomical orientation during standing arm elevation; starting arm at side
McClure2001:ST_UpwardRotation_deg.supporting_source: McClure et al. 2001, pp. 270-272, Figure 2 and Figure 3B

McClure2001:ST_PosteriorTilt_deg.description: Scapula relative to thorax; third Euler rotation about XS.

McClure2001:ST_InternalRotation_deg.description: CSV stores internal rotation; the paper plots external rotation, hence external orientation appears as negative internal rotation.

McClure2001:SC_Elevation_deg.description: Clavicular elevation derived from tracked sternal notch and AC joint locations; clavicle not directly tracked.
McClure2001:SC_Elevation_deg.distal_coordinate_system: AC joint position tracked by scapular receiver
McClure2001:SC_Elevation_deg.unresolved_ambiguity: Derived clavicular angle, not a directly measured SC joint rotation.

McClure2001:ST_UpwardRotation_deg.description: CSV sign already matches positive upward rotation in Figure 3B.

McClure2001:ST_PosteriorTilt_deg.description: CSV sign already matches positive posterior tilt in Figure 3A.

McClure2001:ST_InternalRotation_deg.description: CSV has already encoded the paper's external-rotation plot as negative internal rotation.

McClure2001:SC_Elevation_deg.description: CSV sign matches positive clavicular elevation.
